user_query: I'm redecorating my living room and I need some design inspiration. Can you suggest different interior design styles and furniture options? Additionally, I'd like to know the preferences of my family members in terms of color schemes, furniture materials, and preferred decor themes.

TaskList.description: Research popular interior design styles and compile a list of options.
Identify trending furniture options related to the selected design styles.
Gather preferences from family members regarding color schemes, furniture materials, and decor themes.
Analyze the collected family preferences and suggest personalized design choices.
